hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */backend/*.py) rel="${f##*/backend/}"; if [ -n "$(docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yml ps --status running -q api 2>/dev/null)" ]; then docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yml exec -T api ruff check --fix "/app/$rel"; fi ;; esac; } || true
hooks.statusMessage: Linting backend file (ruff, if dev stack is up)...

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */apps/web/*.ts|*/apps/web/*.tsx) (cd apps/web && ./node_modules/.bin/eslint --fix "$f") ;; esac; } || true
